summary.name: Zapier AI
summary.one_liner: Zapier's AI offering connects AI tools and agents to thousands of business apps, letting teams build AI-powered workflows, agents, and chatbots with centralized governance.
keywords: zapier alternative to ai automation tools
use_cases: Triaging and auto-replying to support tickets
Building AI agents that run business tasks
Governing how employees use AI tools across company apps
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Zapier as a platform for connecting AI tools to business apps (9,000+ apps and 400+ AI tools are mentioned) and turning them into automated workflows. It offers AI steps inside workflows, custom AI agents, and customer chatbots. Zapier MCP is presented as a governance layer where admins control which apps and actions AI agents can use, with actions logged in an audit log. Governance features named include PII, prompt injection, and toxicity checks on AI steps, LLM provider restrictions, and BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) configuration. The page also describes "Fluid Determinism," where Zapier suggests where AI is needed and reduces token use for steps that run the same way each time.
notable: Zapier MCP as a single governance layer for AI agents with admin controls and audit logs
Fluid Determinism: uses AI only where needed to reduce token cost while keeping deterministic steps
PII, prompt injection, and toxicity checks on AI steps; BYOM support
SOC 2 Type II, GDPR/CCPA compliance, and SAML SSO with SCIM provisioning
caveats: Enterprise-only items such as automatic AI model opt-out and some governance controls are mentioned; full features may depend on plan
Page says 'Start free' but does not list specific prices or free-tier limits
